# AgenticOS — Hong Kong Bilingual AI Governance & Workflow Templates (CC BY 4.0)

> Open bilingual (Traditional Chinese `zh-HK` and English) Markdown governance policies and operational verification checklists for Hong Kong SMEs, Quantity Surveying (QS) & fit-out engineering teams, and compliance leads. Maintained by AgenticOS (https://agenticos.hk).

## Canonical Host & Documentation
- Product Home (zh-HK): https://agenticos.hk/
- Product Home (English): https://agenticos.hk/en/
- Hong Kong Workflow Consultation: https://agenticos.hk/automation-consultation/
- Platform Support Docs: https://docs.agenticos.hk/
- Canonical LLM Context Index: https://agenticos.hk/llms.txt
- Full Bilingual Corpus: https://agenticos.hk/llms-full.txt
- AI Resource Discovery (ARD): https://agenticos.hk/.well-known/ard.json
